claims: Remove the batteries from the TV remote.
Dip a cotton swab in white vinegar or lemon juice to gently scrub the corrosion.
Use a small brush or sandpaper to clean remaining residue.
Ensure the compartment is completely dry before inserting new batteries.

claims.text: To clean battery corrosion, first take the batteries out, put on gloves and glasses, and spread newspaper.
Dab vinegar or lemon juice on the crust with a cotton swab, wait a minute, and then wipe it off.
Scrub stubborn spots with an old toothbrush, wipe with rubbing alcohol, and let it dry completely before fitting fresh batteries.
